title: The Afterword — Babette
metaDescription: Post-event feedback for Babette. Candour welcome. Long answers are a gift.
heading: THE
AFTER
WORD
intro: The party’s over; the tablecloths are in the wash. Tell us how it really was — and don’t be brief on our account. Long answers are a gift: the more you tell us, the better we get.
subject: Afterword — post-event feedback

success.message: Read, noted, taken to heart. Thank you for telling us straight — every word of it.

fields.name: names
fields.label: Your names
fields.error: So we know whose day we’re learning from.

fields.name: overall
fields.label: Overall, the day was…
fields.error: Pick the closest one — you can qualify it below.

fields.name: first_image
fields.label: Close your eyes. What’s the first image of the day that comes back?
fields.placeholder: Start anywhere — the light, a face, a plate, a song…
fields.hint: Ramble freely. We read every word, twice.
fields.error: Give us one picture — however small.

fields.name: guests_talked_about
fields.label: What did your guests not stop talking about?
fields.placeholder: The thing people mentioned in the taxi home, or texted you about the morning after…

fields.name: best_decision
fields.label: What was the best decision we made together?
fields.placeholder: And what nearly talked you out of it…

fields.name: do_differently
fields.label: And honestly — what should we have done differently?
fields.placeholder: Spare nothing. This is the part we read most carefully…
fields.hint: Candour is the kindest thing you can give us.

fields.name: wobble
fields.label: Was there a moment things wobbled — and how did we catch it?
fields.placeholder: Every event has one. We’d rather hear about ours…

fields.name: in_a_sentence
fields.label: If you described Babette to a stranger in one sentence — what would you say?
fields.placeholder: Exactly as you’d say it out loud, wine in hand…

fields.name: recommend
fields.label: Would you send a friend to us?
fields.error: One tick — it tells us most of what we need.

fields.name: testimonial_invite
fields.text: You may write to me about sharing a few of these words publicly.
Nothing here is published anywhere — this page is for our eyes only, unless you tick the box above and we come to an agreement together.
